note: Project-added extensions to the synced Nova Spektr UI kit. These are NOT part of the upstream nova-spektr-ui-kit npm package; they were added to faithfully rebuild app screens (network/token chip icons + Polkadot identicon/SS58 helpers). Keep them when re-syncing the kit.
addedBy: design-sync project work — Multisig Operations screen

globals.nsPolkadotIcon: (seed, size=64) => dataURI SVG — genuine Polkadot identicon. seed may be an SS58 address (decoded to its pubkey) or any string.
globals.nsAddress: (seed, prefix=0) => valid SS58 address (0=Polkadot, 2=Kusama, 42=generic), deterministic from seed.

features.name: MultisigOperations
features.title: Multisig Operations
features.description: Full Multisig Operations screen rebuilt 1:1 from the Nova Spektr app (novasamatech/nova-spektr). Sidebar, Pending/History tabs, filters with dropdowns, search, grouped operation rows (type icon, chain, token amount, account identicon, N-of-M status, Reject/Approve), and an expandable details + signatories panel. Uses the kit components plus the assets/ icons and lib/identicon.js extensions.
